title: Man Overboard Part 1
summary: A man is found dead on a boat. At first, a group of women who were vacationing were suspected but they found a cuff link belonging to someone who went back to the UK after the murder.
method: The killer hid in the cupboard of the boat and waited for the police to arrive.
motive: The victim is the killer's dad and he resents him for choosing to save his brother instead of him during a boat trip years ago.
notes: First appearance of DI Jack Mooney. Two DIs investigate.
